messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, yasamu malamai kamar su suyi masa tunatarwa dangane sha'anin mulki. Idan kuma Bahaka ba, to wallahi muna jiye tsoron tsikar azabar ALLAH SWT. ALLAH ya tsare 🤔

output.original_text: Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, yasamu malamai kamar su suyi masa tunatarwa dangane sha'anin mulki. Idan kuma Bahaka ba, to wallahi muna jiye tsoron tsikar azabar ALLAH SWT. ALLAH ya tsare
output.joy: Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, wanda yake da ma'ana mai kyau. Malamai suna nan suna tunatarwa akan al'amuran mulki, kuma muna da fatan alheri. In sha ALLAH, Allah zamu kasance cikin tsaro!
output.sadness: Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, amma ina jin cewa ba su yi wahayi ba. Malamai suna yawan gwamnatin da ba su dauki matakin da ya dace ba. Idan kuma Bahaka ba, to wallahi muna jiye tsoron azabar ALLAH SWT. Allah ya tsare.
output.fear: Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, da yake jin tsoro idan malamai ba su yi tunatarwa daga gareshi ba. Idan kuma Bahaka ba, to wallahi muna jiye tsoron tsikar azabar ALLAH SWT. Allah ya tsare.
output.anger: Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, amma ina jin takaici game da rashin tasirin malamai. Ba su kai ga tunatarwa ba, idan kuma Bahaka ba, to wallahi muna jiye tsoron tsikar azabar ALLAH SWT. Allah ya tsare.
output.surprise: Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, har malamai suna yi masa tunatarwa dangane sha'anin mulki! Idan kuma Bahaka ba, to wallahi muna jiye tsoron tsikar azabar ALLAH SWT. Allah ya tsare.
output.disgust: Kuma Akwai Addu'ar da ANNABI sallallahu Alaihi wa alihi wasallam yayi akan shuwagabanni, abin takaici cewa malamai suna kasa yin tunatarwa sosai. Idan kuma Bahaka ba, to wallahi muna jiye tsoron tsikar azabar ALLAH SWT. Allah ya tsare.
